There's no direct function for assists; only top scorer. So maybe answer manually: Historically, Ryan Giggs had many assists but not sure. Actually leading assist provider all-time in EPL is Ryan Giggs (171). Or it's actually Ryan Giggs has 171 assists as of his retirement. Also other players like Frank Lampard also high.

But question ambiguous: "most assist player" could refer to current season's highest assist count. We don't have function for that. Could approximate known stats: For 2022-23 season, Kevin De Bruyne led with 12 assists. In 2023-24 so far, etc. Might need up-to-date info. Without external search, I guess they'd accept general knowledge: As of my last update, Ryan Giggs holds record for most assists in Premier League history with 171.
